steps.title: Open the TV guide
steps.detail: Tap “TV & smart-home guide.” If you finished it before, tap “Replay connection guide.”

steps.title: Choose your TV
steps.detail: Pick the brand printed on your TV. If the guide asks which TV system you use, choose the one shown on your TV.

steps.title: Move one step at a time
steps.detail: Tap Next for the next picture. Tap Back to see the previous step again.

steps.title: Start the check
steps.detail: On Sound, tap “Live sound check,” then “Start sound check.”

steps.title: Choose whether to use the microphone
steps.detail: If asked, allow microphone access to try the check. Tap “Start sound check” again when you are ready.

steps.title: Speak and watch the bars
steps.detail: The bars show sound reaching this device. Tap “Stop sound check” to finish early. The check ends after 30 seconds.

steps.title: Choose the TV you use
steps.detail: Tap “Set up your TV.” Select your TV brand and follow the pictures for your TV system.

steps.title: Find the model if the guide asks
steps.detail: Look for “Model” on the TV information screen, on its box, or on a label you can reach. AB-123 in this picture is an example.

steps.title: Follow the next picture
steps.detail: Use Next and Back to move through the guide. Follow any pairing instructions on your own TV.

steps.title: Find the word “Model”
steps.detail: Look beside it for letters and numbers. Use your own TV’s model. The illustration shows an example.

steps.title: To type it, tap “Full model number”
steps.detail: Enter the letters, numbers, and dashes. Tap Next to continue.

steps.title: Or tap “Read model from photo”
steps.detail: Aim at the model label. When the app reads it, the next step opens. Check that the number matches your TV.

steps.title: Read one check
steps.detail: Each entry tells you whether the microphone picked up sound and why the check ended. An empty list means there are no completed checks in this app session.

steps.title: Open Appearance
steps.detail: On Settings, tap the button marked “Appearance.”

steps.title: Pick a background
steps.detail: Choose Daylight for a light background or Midnight for a dark one. Choose System to match your device.

steps.title: Read what a switch does
steps.detail: Tap the question mark beside a setting to read about it.

steps.title: Check whether it stayed on
steps.detail: If you see “Not connected” and the switch moves back to Off, that feature is off.
